source: 更改下次触发时的启动行为，不结束当前进程。
en: Change future startup behavior without stopping running processes.

source: 扫描已取消，保留上次结果。
en: Scan canceled. Previous results are retained.

source: 正在后台读取登录项、任务和服务…
en: Reading logon entries, tasks and services in the background…

source: 没有符合条件的自启动项目
文件路径或服务身份匹配的运行进程：
en: Processes matching the file path or service identity:

source: 进程匹配不代表本次由此入口启动；共享脚本宿主不会仅凭文件名关联。
en: A match does not prove this entry launched the process. Shared script hosts are not linked by filename alone.

source: 仅更改此入口。不会立即运行、停止或重启程序；同一软件的其他入口保持不变。
en: Only this entry will change. No application will be started, stopped or restarted. Other entries for this software remain unchanged.

source: 恢复后将在下一次满足触发条件时生效。
en: The restored entry takes effect when its trigger next occurs.

source: 确认后先保存恢复信息，再禁用此入口。后台功能可能在下次触发时不可用。
en: Recovery information is saved before disabling this entry. Its background features may be unavailable at the next trigger.

source: 读取注册表登录项、启动文件夹、包含隐藏项目的计划任务、自动及触发服务、驱动和高级系统入口。任务也可能按时间或事件触发，并非全部开机执行。
en: Reads registry logon entries, startup folders, scheduled tasks including hidden entries, automatic and triggered services, drivers and advanced system entries. Tasks may run on a schedule or event rather than at boot.

source: 高级系统入口和无法确认状态的项目仅供查看。无法访问的来源、未加载用户配置及读取上限可能导致遗漏；本页不保证找出所有启动机制。
en: Advanced system entries and entries with unverified states are view only. Inaccessible sources, unloaded user profiles and scan limits can leave gaps; this page cannot guarantee every startup mechanism is found.

source: 本次扫描未报告额外读取问题。
en: No additional read issues were reported by this scan.

source: 查看登录、任务和服务等后台启动入口。
en: Inspect logon entries, tasks and background services.

source: 查看程序与进程关系，保留需要的程序。
en: Explore apps and their processes. Keep the ones you need.
